goal.statement: Every completed sale automatically produces a unique, immutable, legally compliant Vietnamese hóa đơn điện tử. Zero completed orders without an invoice. Zero duplicate invoice numbers.
goal.metric: Invoice issuance rate = 100% of completed orders. invoiceNumber collision count = 0. VAT calculation accuracy = 100%.

actors.name: System (automatically triggered)
actors.goal: Issue an invoice the moment payment is confirmed — no human intervention

impacts.action: React to OrderCompletedEvent and create invoice atomically
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Orders complete without invoices — legal violation

impacts.action: Assign a unique sequential invoice number per store per year
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Duplicate or gap invoice numbers — tax audit failure

impacts.action: Calculate VAT correctly per tax rate group
impacts.deliverable: vatCalculationService: group by taxRatePercent, floor integer math
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Incorrect VAT amounts on invoice — regulatory penalty

actors.name: Cashier / Thu ngân
actors.goal: Present the invoice to the customer after payment

impacts.action: View invoice for a completed order
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Cashier cannot show legal receipt to customer

actors.name: Accountant / Kế toán
actors.goal: Reconcile all invoices for monthly VAT declaration

impacts.action: List all invoices filtered by date range and status
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Cannot produce monthly VAT report — file incorrect tax return

impacts.action: Cancel invoice after refund is approved
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Refunded sales still appear as revenue in tax books

actors.name: Store Manager + Admin
actors.goal: Audit invoice records and handle escalated cancellations

impacts.action: View all invoices for store (same as accountant)
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Cannot audit invoice completeness against order history

constraints: Invoice number MUST be immutable after creation — LEGAL-01/LEGAL-02
Invoice cancellation MUST NOT change invoiceNumber — a cancellation note is issued separately
Only system (via event) may create invoices — no manual POST /invoices endpoint
All monetary values in đồng (integer) — no decimal values on invoice
VAT rounding: Math.floor() only — never Math.round() or Math.ceil()
